piping_tag_inventory.note: Tag prefixes and the highest number seen on the drawing. The diagram repeats tags across sheet regions, so a highest number is an upper bound on quantity, NOT a count. Only use these for topology comparison, never as an equipment count.
topology_observations: PCV01-PCV64 is one pod control valve per AI rack, each flanked by isolation valves on the branch.
BAV11-BAV14 is one balancing valve per fan wall; BAV01-BAV10 sit in the plant.
Each CDU carries isolation valves on all four ports; CDU banks tie to a common header pair per pod.
General notes: install air vents at high points, install drainages at low points.

not_published_in_supplied_set: Pipe schedule: diameters per run, materials, insulation, support spacing. Only a DN150 connection size appears.
Pump schedule: duty flow, head, power for CWP1-6. 3.3 states they are to be sized upon design implementation.
Valve schedule: Kv or Cv, allocated pressure drop, operating range or authority for any ISV, PCV or BAV.
CDU pressure-drop curve, primary and secondary flow rates at the rated 2.5 MW.
TCS and FWS design temperatures are not restated in this set; R0 supplies 45/55 C and 40/50 C.
Physical layout. RD113_3.2 states explicitly that it depicts system connections and is not representative of physical layout; RD113_1.1X is the layout drawing and was not supplied.
